input.command:
python -c "exec('''import duckdb, pandas as pd, matplotlib.pyplot as plt
from pathlib import Path
out=Path('out'); out.mkdir(exist_ok=True)
con=duckdb.connect()
query=\"\"\"SELECT CASE strftime(crash_date, '%w') WHEN '0' THEN 'Sunday' WHEN '1' THEN 'Monday' WHEN '2' THEN 'Tuesday' WHEN '3' THEN 'Wednesday' WHEN '4' THEN 'Thursday' WHEN '5' THEN 'Friday' WHEN '6' THEN 'Saturday' END AS weekday, COUNT(*) AS crashes FROM read_parquet('data/crashes.parquet') WHERE crash_date >= DATE '2013-01-01' AND crash_date < DATE '2026-01-01' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY CASE weekday WHEN 'Monday' THEN 1 WHEN 'Tuesday' THEN 2 WHEN 'Wednesday' THEN 3 WHEN 'Thursday' THEN 4 WHEN 'Friday' THEN 5 WHEN 'Saturday' THEN 6 WHEN 'Sunday' THEN 7 END\"\"\"
df=con.execute(query).fetchdf()
df['share_pct']=df['crashes']/df['crashes'].sum()*100
df[['weekday','crashes']].to_csv(out/'values_1.csv',index=False)
df[['weekday','crashes','share_pct']].to_csv(out/'values_2.csv',index=False,float_format='%.6f')
plt.figure(figsize=(9,5.3)); bars=plt.bar(df.weekday,df.crashes,color='#3478a8'); plt.bar_label(bars,labels=[f'{v:,.0f}' for v in df.crashes],padding=3,fontsize=8); plt.title('NYC police-reported crashes by weekday (2013–2025)'); plt.ylabel('Crash records'); plt.xlabel('Day of week'); plt.ylim(0,df.crashes.max()*1.12); plt.grid(axis='y',alpha=.2); plt.tight_layout(); plt.savefig(out/'option_1.png',dpi=180); plt.close()
plt.figure(figsize=(9,5.3)); bars=plt.bar(df.weekday,df.share_pct,color='#e18c3a'); plt.bar_label(bars,labels=[f'{v:.1f}%' for v in df.share_pct],padding=3,fontsize=8); plt.title('Share of NYC police-reported crashes by weekday (2013–2025)'); plt.ylabel('Share of crashes'); plt.xlabel('Day of week'); plt.ylim(0,df.share_pct.max()*1.15); plt.grid(axis='y',alpha=.2); plt.tight_layout(); plt.savefig(out/'option_2.png',dpi=180); plt.close()
print(df.to_string(index=False)); print('TOTAL',int(df.crashes.sum()))
''')"
